title: Visio: Desktop Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
description: The Microsoft Visio Desktop MCP Server enables compatible AI clients to connect with the Visio Desktop application to create, read, and update Visio diagrams using natural language. It runs locally on Windows and requires a licensed Visio Desktop application.
